data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net outstanding claims of USD 1,400.1m (2020: USD 774.1m) is a decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2020 and prior years of account of USD 397.3m (2020: decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2019 and prior years of account USD 145.2m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Net reserves for losses and loss expenses related to the COVID-19 pandemic represent the Syndicate's best estimate of losses and loss expenses incurred at 31 December 2021; COVID-19 has been considered in reserving.

prior_year_events.event_name: Part VII transfer of EEA non-life policies to Lloyd's Brussels
prior_year_events.impact_description: On 30 December 2020 the Syndicate transferred its EEA non-life insurance policies primarily written up to 2019 to Lloyd's Brussels; the value of net liabilities transferred was USD 122.5m for Syndicate 1686 and Syndicate 2007 combined; Lloyd's Brussels subsequently reinsured the same liabilities back to the Syndicate; no gain or loss arose on either transaction.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129
prior_year_events.impact_description: With effect from 1 January 2021 the 2018 year of account of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 closed by way of an RITC into the 2019 year of account of Syndicate 1686; the RITC was accounted for as a balance sheet claims portfolio transfer and increased gross claims outstanding (gross effect shown in the technical provisions note).

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were USD 1,173.605m. The Syndicate reports a net decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2020 and prior years of USD 397.3m, representing a material release of prior-year reserves. The release is attributed to favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries, with COVID-19 considered in reserving. The gross development triangle is distorted by a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction during the year, so the Syndicate's published net prior-year release (USD 397.3m) has been used as the primary quantified measure.
raw_causal_phrases: Net reserves for losses and loss expenses related to the COVID-19 pandemic represents the Syndicate's best estimate of losses and loss expenses that have been incurred at 31 December 2021.

Included within net outstanding claims of USD 1,400.1m (2020: USD 774.1m) is a decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2020 and prior years of account of USD 397.3m (2020: decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2019 and prior years of account USD 145.2m).
The RITC was accounted for as a balance sheet claims portfolio transfer with no entries recorded in the statement of comprehensive income.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening reserves (gross claims outstanding) taken from statement of financial position (explicit). A gross claims development triangle is present, but a large RITC into the 2019 year materially distorts gross movement measures; the report explicitly states a net decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2020 and prior of USD 397.3m, which has been used as the quantified prior-year movement (NET of reinsurance) as a fallback. Where gross prior-year movement could be calculated from the triangle it would be distorted by RITC; therefore gross PYD is not reported and the net figure is used. All amounts reported in native currency (USD).
